cohort: 512 pregnant women with HBV infection and a high serum HBV DNA load (> 2 x 10^5 IU/mL), diagnosed and treated at a hospital between January 2018 and April 2023, were included.
finding: TDF treatment significantly reduced mother-to-child transmission of HBV, increased seroconversion rates of HBV DNA, HBeAg, and HBsAg in mothers and infants, and demonstrated a favorable safety profile.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in cesarean section rates between the TDF-treated and TDF-unexposed groups.
